literal.prompt: При подготовке нового учебника в макет уже внесены авторский текст и иллюстрации. Нужно назначить ответственную сторону за титульную и copyright-страницу с ISBN и данными издания. Кто по руководству отвечает за подготовку этих страниц?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The guide assigns both Title page and Copyright page to Publisher. It lists title/subtitle, author/editor and illustrator on the title page; the copyright page may include publisher identity, ISBN, publication date/history and printing information. The applied task is assigning production responsibility for those pages.; The guide assigns Dedication, Preface, Acknowledgements and Introduction to Author; this is a different responsibility from producing the title/copyright pages.; The title-page row may list an editor alongside the author; the guide still assigns responsibility for preparing the page to Publisher.; The Title page row says the illustrator, if any, is named along with author/editor; naming a contributor does not make that contributor the party assigned to produce the title page.
literalGroups.locator: UH OER Publishing Guide, complete front-matter table: Title page, Copyright page, Dedication, Foreword, Preface and Acknowledgements rows.
